name: Orbita
label: lo spazio, spiegato
audience: Italy (EU) and Italian-speaking Switzerland and San Marino, plus Italian speakers abroad; adults and curious families 18-54; Italian
niche: Space and astronomy explained in Italian: planets, missions, strange objects in the sky and what we can actually see tonight
why: Italy is one of the EU's biggest YouTube markets, with an estimated 40+ million users. Italian space channels already have loyal audiences: Coelum Astronomia has its own YouTube channel, and creators such as Adrian Fartade have built followings in the hundreds of thousands, but almost nobody makes short daily space Shorts in Italian. Space and science content is also advertiser-safe and evergreen, and Italian-language CPMs are among the higher ones in southern Europe. One caveat: today's web search only partly confirmed these figures, so treat the user count and CPM claim as rough estimates to check before launch.
first_videos: There is a planet where it rains glass sideways, at 8,000 km/h
Why the Moon always shows us the same face, and what is on the other side
The Italian astronaut experiment that is still running in orbit today
Tonight you can see Saturn with your naked eye: here is exactly where to look
A star so big that if it replaced the Sun, it would swallow Jupiter
tagline: Il cielo, una storia alla volta
description:
Orbita racconta lo spazio in meno di un minuto: pianeti, stelle, missioni spaziali e i misteri del cosmo, spiegati con parole semplici e fonti verificate.

Ogni giorno pubblichiamo 2 Shorts: curiosità sull'universo, le scoperte più recenti delle agenzie spaziali e consigli su cosa osservare nel cielo sopra l'Italia.

Orbita è un canale Hopeverse Media realizzato con l'intelligenza artificiale. Made by AI. Made with hope.
